title: Prioritization Under Deadline Pressure
question: Tell me about a time you had competing high-priority tasks with tight deadlines. How did you decide what to focus on?

rubric.name: situation_context
rubric.description: Explains competing demands, stakeholders, and time constraints.

rubric.name: prioritization_framework
rubric.description: Details systematic framework used to evaluate urgency vs impact.

rubric.name: stakeholder_communication
rubric.description: Communicates trade-offs, expectations, and scope adjustments proactively.

rubric.name: execution_result
rubric.description: Delivers core priorities on time while maintaining quality.

rubric.name: reflection
rubric.description: Reflects on workflow improvements to prevent deadline crunches.

expected_signals: Uses structured criteria (e.g. user impact, business value, technical risk)
Communicates early with stakeholders about re-scoped deliverables
Avoids burnout by setting clear technical boundaries
red_flags: Tries to do everything poorly without setting expectations
Silently drops tasks without informing stakeholders
Fails to explain rationale behind prioritization choices
follow_up_prompts: How did you handle pushback from stakeholders whose tasks were deprioritized?
What criteria did you use to distinguish critical scope from nice-to-have features?
